name: advent-neon
features: centered 1280x960 views and ports with 120 extra world pixels above and below
4:3 camera, GUI, pause capture, shader compositor, and video reset paths
expanded splash, cutscene, dialogue, objective, boss-intro, transition, training, stage-stat, and stage-clear UI
always-visible mobile control artwork hidden while input handling is preserved
title-scene and controls-guide foregrounds centered in the 4:3 frame
flash-warning foreground centered independently from its tiled background
recognized GameMaker runner startup logos replaced by a plain black loading frame
known_limitations: The result is structurally verified but has not yet been visually verified on a device.
Previously unauthored vertical world/background space, particles, cinematics, or encounter framing may need follow-up adjustments.
The visual mobile-control overlay is intentionally hidden; this does not add new controller mappings.

compatibility.strategy: named GameMaker project/resource checks plus guarded semantic source fragments and patched postconditions
notes: The tested source was verified with UndertaleModCli 0.9.2.0.
APKVision cleanup remains optional and is handled by the shared framework.
